CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArraySet

Assigns one value to every element from a start position to an end position, growing the array if the range goes past its end.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArraySet(array, start_pos, end_pos, value)

Parameters

array
A one-dimensional array.
start_pos
First position to set.
end_pos
Last position to set.
value
The value given to every element in the range.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

Handy for initializing counters to 0 before a loop. If the value is a structure, every element refers to the same structure; use a loop with StructNew if each element needs its own.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Seven zeroed counters, one per weekday --->
<CFSET Hits = ArrayNew(1)>
<CFSET Temp = ArraySet(Hits, 1, 7, 0)>
<CFSET Hits[3] = Hits[3] + 42>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><CFLOOP INDEX="d" FROM="1" TO="7"><TH>#Left(DayOfWeekAsString(d), 3)#</TH></CFLOOP></TR>
<TR><CFLOOP INDEX="d" FROM="1" TO="7"><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Hits[d]#</TD></CFLOOP></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArrayResize, ArrayNew, ArrayClear
